overview:
The **Battle of Saleucami** (19 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Clone Wars**, fought on or above **Saleucami**. Stass allie's 91st mobile recon corps pursuing separatist forces across saleucami's misty wetlands on speeder bikes before clone troopers execute order 66.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Clone Wars in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Saleucami within the broader **Clone Wars** campaign. Front-line reports describe stass allie's 91st mobile recon corps pursuing separatist forces across saleucami's misty wetlands on speeder bikes before clone troopers execute order 66.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **19 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Clone Wars.
significance: The Battle of Saleucami illustrates how the Clone Wars reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
